title: AI Cinematic Product Video From One Photo | AIVideosUGC
description: AI cinematic product video from one photo with moody light and a slow camera move. Use 16:9 for web or 9:16 for Shorts/Reels, with 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds.
h1: Cinematic Product Video From One Still Photo
lead: Pick a moody reveal and add one photo, so the product gets a slow camera move without a film crew.

steps.d: Use a sharp photo with the full silhouette in frame. A clear edge gives the move something to follow.
Name the surface, one light, and one slow move. Then pick 16:9 or 9:16 and a length from 6 to 30 seconds.
Download the file and add a licensed track in your editor. The clip does not include music or captions.

faq.q: What is a cinematic product video template?
faq.a: A ready scene that gives one product photo a controlled light and a slow reveal. You bring the still, and the clip opens like a short brand film.

faq.q: How do I make the film?
faq.a: Upload a sharp photo, name the surface, one light, and one camera move, pick a size and a length, then download the file.

faq.q: Why start from a photo instead of a film crew?
faq.a: The set, the light, and the move are generated from the photo you already have. You skip the crew, the rental, and the reshoot.
Shops with a clear product shape or finish, such as speakers, bottles, lamps, watches, and sunglasses, that want a polished open for a page or an ad.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Start with a sharp full-silhouette photo and name one move, such as a slow push-in or a short side glide. Check the edge before you post.
A sharp photo with the full product in frame, clear edges, and enough contrast against the background.

faq.q: Which size and length can I pick?
faq.a: This template is set up for 16:9 and 9:16. The product also offers 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3 or 3:4. Lengths are 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and the credit cost is shown before the job runs.
24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 and 120 for 30. A failed job returns those credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month.

faq.q: Does the clip include music or my logo?
faq.a: No music and no captions. Add a licensed track in your editor. A logo that is part of your uploaded product can remain. Another company's logo or trademark may be rejected.

faq.q: Can I run the file in ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark and can run on your site and in paid ads. Review reflective frames for glare before you post. The clip is your ad, not a customer quote.
